description:
Metalheads are dedicated fans of Heavy Metal music who adhere to a subculture characterized by shared fashion, rituals, and an ideology of authenticity and alienation from mainstream society. The subculture emerged in the 1970s alongside pioneering bands like Black Sabbath and Judas Priest and has persisted far longer than most rock genres due to the growth of this intense, exclusionary youth community. [ 1 ]

The Metalhead community maintains a rigorous "code of authenticity," which demands that both performers and fans demonstrate deep loyalty to the music, a disinterest in commercial appeal (a refusal to "sell out"), and a general opposition to established authority. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Authenticity (anti- poser ), loyalty, anti-commercialism (refusal to "sell out"), devotion to metal music
